messages:
amanda: Quick ask — can we lock a 30m slot next week for an inference perf review? Need to go over the latest latency dashboard and quantization perf.

sasha: I'm +1. Prefer Tue/Wed afternoons. Can we do 3:30pm PT? :clock330: 

mateo: Tue 3:30 works for me. Is this the same readout as last month? Need to include the new KV-cache change results.

amanda: Not exactly — this is the preflight before the customer demo. Agenda (30m):
- 5m quick context
- 10m latency distribution + regressed endpoints
- 10m cost/throughput vs quantized variants
- 5m action items + owners

jordan: I'll present the latency graphs. I'll upload the deck — link: https://drive.redwood/reports/latency-preflight (will update by EOD)

amanda: Can someone run the perf query and paste the 99p baseline here? need it for the deck.

ops-bot: perf-query finished: 99p latency = 187ms (prod, seq=1024, model=redwood-v1-q4)

mateo: thx. also cc @eng-oncall for any infra concerns.

amanda: ok locking Tue 3:30pm PT — calendar invite sent. If blockers, reply here. Please skim the deck and comment on the PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/482

sasha: skimmed — one nit on chart labels.

jordan: will do a quick run-through in #eng-runtime 1h before the meeting.

amanda: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup:
